findings.justification: E11 is a derived metric showing operating margin for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 was 0.1369 (13.69%), which is less than 15%. The period_status is COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION and the period matches the claim period exactly (3 months ended 2026-06-30). This directly contradicts the assertion that operating margin exceeded 15%.

E7 shows operating income of $27,461 million for Q2 2026 (2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30), and E8 shows revenue of $200,606 million for the same period. Both have period_status EXACT_MATCH. The operating margin is 27,461/200,606 = 13.69%, which is less than 15%, contradicting the claim.

findings.key_quote: Operating income increased from $19.2 billion in Q2 2025 to $27.5 billion in Q2 2026
findings.justification: E1 provides operating income for Q2 2026 ($27.5 billion) but does not provide revenue for the same period in this passage, so operating margin cannot be determined from this evidence alone. The period_status is UNKNOWN because the passage covers multiple durations.

E11 shows operating margin of 0.1369 for the quarter ended 2026-06-30, which is not greater than 0.15. The period_status is COMPATIBLE_AFTER_VERIFIED_DERIVATION and matches the claim period. This contradicts the numeric assertion.

E7 and E8 together show operating margin of 27,461/200,606 = 0.1369 for Q2 2026, which is not greater than 0.15. Both facts have period_status EXACT_MATCH for the claim period. This contradicts the numeric assertion.
